description: This file defines an interface for a key-value storage library, which includes functions for saving, loading, deleting, and managing data in namespaces. It also supports loading XML and JSON data with validation and custom parsing, along with functions for backup and retrieval of metadata. The file includes licensing information and header guards, indicating it's a well-structured C header for storage operations in a larger software project.

methods.name: storageSave
methods.description: Save a value string under a specified namespace and key.

methods.name: storageLoad
methods.description: Retrieve a value string for a given namespace and key.

methods.name: storageLoadXML
methods.description: Load and parse an XML document from storage.

methods.name: storageLoadJSON
methods.description: Load and parse a JSON document from storage.

methods.name: storageParse
methods.description: Load data from storage and validate it using a custom parser.

methods.name: storageDelete
methods.description: Delete a specific key from a namespace.

methods.name: storageDeleteNamespace
methods.description: Delete an entire namespace and its contents.

methods.name: storageRestoreNamespace
methods.description: Restore a namespace from a backup location, overwriting existing data.

methods.name: storageGetKeys
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all keys in a namespace.

methods.name: getStorageDir
methods.description: Get the storage directory name used by the library.

methods.name: storageGetMtime
methods.description: Get the last modification time of a specific key.
